|errata_history=This is the original printing (version 1 of 5) of the Virtual Modern card. It is not the current version; the current version is [[First Order Stormtrooper (Errata 4)]] (PC-E4). The image is the Players Committee printing of this version ([[:File:V4-D-firstorderstormtrooper-2018-07-08.gif]]). Each version below is a published PC printing (card image or errata sheet slip); card-image dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later), slip dates are the errata sheet's PDF date. Every visibly different printing is a separate version, and an errata sheet slip is a version of its own, separate from the card image of the same errata (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). '''Errata mark:''' the earliest image found already prints “E”: the PC had issued an errata of this card before its image repository began (8 July 2018), and no printing of the earlier text was found (searched: the PC errata sheets of 2019–2023, the Holotable image history including other file names, and the 2021 set sheets). Listed with the [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription errors]] (marks that do not match the version).
* '''Original''' (this page): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018<ref name="img-firstorderstormtroop022435b">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual4-Dark/large/firstorderstormtrooper.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b] (by 8 July 2018); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual4-Dark/large/firstorderstormtrooper.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref> (earliest copy found: the first commit of the repository; the card was printed earlier and no earlier image of it was found). Document: errata mark “E”; bottom margin “Stormtrooper”. Text: “Deploys free to same site as a First Order leader. Opponent's characters here are cumulatively defense value -1 (limit -3).”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[First Order Stormtrooper (Errata)]]): PC errata sheet slip (december2019errata.pdf, page 1), PDF dated 6 December 2019<ref name="slip-fos-dec2019">Players Committee errata sheet [https://res.starwarsccg.org/wp/wp-content/uploads/2019/12/december2019errata.pdf#page=1 december2019errata.pdf], page 1; the date is the PDF's creation date (6 December 2019).</ref>. '''What changed:''' “Deploys free to same” → “Deploys -1 to same”; a different printing: the errata sheet slip (printed for sleeving over the card) replaces the card image. Opponent's characters here are cumulatively defense value -1 (limit -3).”
